name: Aslan
source:
Age: ???
Zodiac: Capricorn

Aslan is an easy going bartender who works in the town's local pub. He usually listens to MC's troubles and offers kind words in return.
...But no one ever sees him outside of the bar. It's almost as if he vanishes into thin air. There's a rumor that he's looking for someone in town.
